name: @app/api-client
//: ESM, unlike @app/types and @app/ordering which emit CommonJS for apps/api. This package is consumed only by bundlers (Vite for the web app, Metro for the Expo app) and it ships runtime code, not just erased types — Rollup cannot name-import from a CJS module, so CJS output breaks `pnpm build` in apps/web.
